title: ScopeDataset — Statistics Panel Data
description: ScopeDatasets provide pre-computed tabular statistics displayed in the site's Analysis/Statistics panel. Each dataset defines its schema (columns), chart configuration, and optionally spatial geometries for map highlighting.

key_fields.site_scope_id: Integer. Foreign key to SiteScope. Required.
key_fields.slug: Unique identifier per site_scope. Format: alphanumeric with hyphens or underscores.
key_fields.name: Display name shown in the statistics panel.
key_fields.group_key: Groups multiple variants of the same dataset (e.g. 'ecoregion-summary'). Variants with the same group_key appear as a switchable selector in the UI.
key_fields.variant_label: Human-readable label for this variant within a group (e.g. 'JRC', 'FAO-WOCAT', 'Trends.Earth').
key_fields.dimension: Spatial aggregation level (e.g. 'ecoregion', 'country', 'admin2'). Used to create radio-button dimension switchers.
key_fields.display_order: Integer. Controls sort order in the statistics panel.
key_fields.schema_config: JSON array defining columns. See schema_config format below.
key_fields.chart_config: JSON array of chart specifications. See chart_config format below.
key_fields.data: JSON array of row objects. Required for model validation. Each row must match schema_config columns.

fields.name: Column name matching the data row keys.
fields.label: Human-readable column header.
fields.prefix: Optional string prefix for display, e.g. '$'.
fields.sufix: Optional string suffix for display, e.g. 'ha'.

chart_config_types.bar: Vertical bar chart. Fields: type, id, title, valueKey, categoryKey, colors, aggregation, tooltipUnit.
chart_config_types.pie: Pie chart. Fields: type, id, title, valueKey, categoryKey, colors.
chart_config_types.scatter: Scatter plot. Fields: type, id, title, xAxis {key, label}, yAxis {key, label}.
chart_config_types.table: Data table. Fields: type, id, title, columns (array of schema column names to show), unitIdColumn.
chart_config_types.kpi: KPI summary cards. Fields: type, id, title, metrics [{key, label, format, aggregation}].

notes: data field is required by model validation — must be a non-empty JSON array.
The update endpoint only accepts config fields (schema_config, chart_config, dimension_config, etc.) — not data.
Spatial geometries for map highlighting are managed separately via scope_dataset_geometries.
Multiple datasets with the same group_key on the same site_scope create variant switcher UI.
